column1: # Source: Downey et al. 2024 Hum Brain Mapp, PMID 39720868, PMC11669040, Supplementary Table 1 (HBM-45-e70118-s001.docx, from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC11669040/supplementaryFiles). Caption: "Representation of each digit by array ... whether it overlaid a functional map of a given digit and what percentage of electrodes evoked a projected field on that digit. Percentages do not sum to 100, as projected fields for a single electrode could include multiple digits." Hand segments reported <30% of the time on a channel were excluded (paper methods). Map "--" as in source (digit not tested in imaging). Transcribed verbatim.
